headline: Nintendo’s designers strove for ‘elegance’ when remaking Ocarina of Time
summary: The Ocarina of Time remake blends original N64 feel with modern graphics. Developers aimed for "elegance" in the Switch 2 version. The project merges past and present in gameplay and development.

headline: X says its updated web app is way faster
summary: X is rolling out a new, much faster web app. The update is deploying "one country at a time" for signed-in users. Principal engineer Yagiz Nizipli detailed improvements in a blog post.

headline: Qualcomm is betting big on data centers as smartphone sales sink
summary: Qualcomm is shifting focus to data centers due to a 20% drop in smartphone sales. The company plans to boost its AI data center business. New partnerships with Amazon and Meta were announced for this strategy.

headline: 17 better ways Elon Musk could have wasted $446 million
summary: The article critiques Elon Musk's spending habits. It suggests social media can be detrimental to mental well-being. The piece offers alternative uses for a large sum of money.

headline: John Constantine Movie From Evil Dead Wrath Filmmaker is in Development at DC
summary: A new John Constantine movie is in development at DC. The film will be directed by the Evil Dead Wrath filmmaker. Further details about the project are expected.

headline: Captain Price Actor Barry Sloane Says He's the Most Qualified Person to Star in the Call of Duty Movie
summary: Barry Sloane, voice of Captain Price, wants to star in the Call of Duty movie. He claims to be the most qualified actor for the role. Sloane has voiced the iconic character in the game series.

headline: World of Warcraft Forever Launch Live Blog: It's Looking Like a Smooth Blizzard Launch
summary: World of Warcraft Forever is having its launch day. A live blog is tracking the release. Initial reports suggest a smooth launch for the Blizzard title.

headline: Scarlett Johansson Says The Batman: Part 2 Role Caused 'Existential Angst'
summary: Scarlett Johansson discusses her challenging role in The Batman: Part II. She described the character as "hard to crack" causing "existential angst". The specific character she plays remains undisclosed.

headline: Vance walks Trump tightrope with scathing election critique blaming Iran war
summary: Vice-president Vance delivered a sharp critique of the Republican election defeat. He linked the loss to the "Iran war," marking a significant break with the president. This assessment is one of the boldest from a sitting vice-president in recent memory.

headline: UK commits to 'time-bound' talks on slavery apology
summary: The UK has pledged "time-bound" talks regarding a slavery apology. British diplomats aim to show urgency on the issue. A firm date for these discussions has not yet been confirmed.

headline: The NHS is relying more on charities - and that might be creating problems for patients
summary: The NHS is increasingly dependent on charitable organizations. This reliance may be causing issues for patients. The article questions if this trend signals a breaking point or public involvement.

headline: Joshua Wong, face of Hong Kong's pro-democracy protests, jailed for 10 years
summary: Joshua Wong, prominent Hong Kong pro-democracy activist, sentenced to 10 years. He is among hundreds jailed under the national security law. Wong, 30, was a key figure in the protests.
